\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newcommand{\lean}[1]{}

\title{Doubling Small Numbers}
\author{A synthetic example}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:ten}\lean{MainUse.le_ten}
If $n \le 5$, then $2n \le 10$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:bound}\lean{MainUse.bound_faithful, MainUse.bound_variant}
If $n \le 5$, then $n + n \le 10$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}\lean{MainUse.main_result}
If $n \le 4$, then $2n \le 10$.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
